name: Sakuragi Ayana
source:
She is a pure and innocent receptionist who is renowned as the most beautiful woman in the company.

Despite the fact that she has a fiancée, she is carried away by the effects of an aphrodisiac spray 
and ends up having sex with the main character...?

[From [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/5638]official site[/url]]
